name: @windowkit/win32
description: Mechanism-only Win32 bridge for Node.js: HWNDs on a UI thread of their own, DirectComposition surfaces, a Direct2D verb table and DirectWrite text — the Windows half of react-x11.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:window && npm run test:shell && npm run test:a11y && npm run test:identity && npm run test:pane && npm run test:gpu
scripts.test:unit: node test/smoke.js && node test/text.js && node test/bezels.js
scripts.test:window: node test/clips.js && node test/states.js && node test/dnd.js && node test/ime.js

author: Andrey Sidorov <andrey.sidorov@gmail.com>
